    Run DTW-based phase-distribution similarity analysis

    run_dtw_similarity.Rd

    This function compares cell-phase distributions across celltype-by-group combinations using dynamic time warping (DTW). For each combination, inferred cell phases are converted into a circular histogram. Pairwise DTW distances between histograms are then converted to a 0-to-1 similarity matrix.

    run_dtw_similarity(
  res_phase,
  metadata,
  theta_by = "theta_pred",
  celltype_by = "celltype",
  group_by = "condition",
  group_levels = NULL,
  celltype_levels = NULL,
  n_bin = 24,
  min_cell = 10,
  normalize_distance = TRUE,
  Verbose = FALSE
)

    Arguments

    res_phase

    A data.frame returned by infer_cell_phase(). It must contain "cell" and the column specified by theta_by.

    metadata

    A data.frame containing cell-level metadata.

    theta_by

    A character vector specifying the column name in res_phase that contains inferred cell phase in radians. Defaults to "theta_pred".

    celltype_by

    A character vector specifying the column name in metadata that defines cell types. Defaults to "celltype".

    group_by

    A character vector specifying the column name in metadata that defines groups or conditions. Defaults to "condition".

    group_levels

    A character vector specifying group order. If NULL, groups are sorted automatically. Defaults to NULL.

    celltype_levels

    A character vector specifying cell-type order. If NULL, cell types are sorted automatically. Defaults to NULL.

    n_bin

    A numeric value specifying the number of circular histogram bins. Defaults to 24.

    min_cell

    A numeric value specifying the minimum number of cells required for a celltype-by-group combination. Defaults to 10.

    normalize_distance

    A logical value indicating whether DTW distance should be normalized by warping path length. Defaults to TRUE.

    Verbose

    A logical value indicating whether progress messages should be printed. Defaults to FALSE.

    Value

    An object of class scRhythmDTWSimilarity, containing:

    data

    Merged cell-level phase and metadata table.

    histogram

    Circular histogram table for each celltype-by-group combination.

    combo

    Cell-count summary for retained combinations.

    annotation

    Annotation table matched to rows and columns of the matrices.

    distance

    Pairwise DTW distance matrix.

    similarity

    Pairwise 0-to-1 DTW similarity matrix.

    params

    Parameters used for the analysis.

    Details

    Cells are matched between res_phase and metadata by the cell column.

    Examples

    if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
data("srb_example_data")

res_phase <- infer_cell_phase(
  count = srb_example_data$Count,
  metadata = srb_example_data$meta,
  ZT_by = "ZT",
  strata_by = "celltype",
  Species = "mouse",
  setseed = 1,
  Verbose = FALSE
)

dtw_res <- run_dtw_similarity(
  res_phase = res_phase,
  metadata = srb_example_data$meta,
  celltype_by = "celltype",
  group_by = "condition",
  min_cell = 10,
  Verbose = TRUE
)

dtw_res
dim(dtw_res$similarity)
dtw_res$similarity[1:3, 1:3]
head(dtw_res$histogram)
} # }
